syllabus_source.body: The Institute of Cost Accountants of India (ICMAI)
syllabus_source.note: Checked 2026-09-29; icmai.in still lists Syllabus 2022. News reports say ICMAI is preparing Syllabus 2026, expected to apply from the June 2027 term; re-check then. Topic names are our own short wording of each paper's sections/modules.

topics.name: Paper 1: Business Laws and Business Communication
Sources of law and the Indian court system
Paper 2: Financial and Cost Accounting basics
Accounting basics, journal to trial balance, depreciation
Consignment, joint venture and bills of exchange

en: trading and profit and loss account

topics.name: Cost accounting basics and cost sheet
Commercial laws: contract, sale of goods, NI, partnership, LLP
Final accounts, non-profit bodies, incomplete records
Branch, departmental, lease, hire purchase, insurance claims
Income tax basics and residential status
Total income and tax of individuals and HUF
Basics of costing and the cost sheet

en: reconciliation of cost and financial accounts

topics.name: Methods of costing: job, batch, contract, process, operating
Standard costing (material and labour) and budgets
Production planning, OR tools, productivity and quality
Company final accounts (Schedule III) and cash flow
Banking, electricity and insurance company accounts
Paper 11: Financial Management and Business Data Analytics
FM basics and time value of money
Sources of finance and cost of capital
SEBI, competition, FEMA and sector laws
Investment decisions, risk, leasing and securitisation
Paper 15: Direct Tax Laws and International Taxation
Tax of individuals, companies, trusts and others
Tax planning, business restructuring, ICDS, black money
Strategic cost management and quality costs
Decision making, ABM, JIT and performance
Quantitative techniques: LP, transport, assignment, games, simulation, learning curve
Cost audit, cost records rules and audit report
Internal control, internal and operational audit
Paper 19: Indirect Tax Laws and Practice
GST in depth: supply, ITC, refunds, returns, audit, disputes
Paper 20A: Strategic Performance Management and Business Valuation (elective)
Paper 20B: Risk Management in Banking and Insurance (elective)
Risk in banking: interest rate, market, credit, liquidity, operational
